QuestInfo.name: Finding Sophia
QuestInfo.1: In #m10000000#, I met a heavily bearded crew member named #p102#. He does have the #b#t4031009##k, but explained that, in order for it to work properly, it needs a #b#t4031011##k. He told me that he'll hand the medicine over if I can bring one to him. To get the #b#t4031011##k, I need to head to #m10004002# and speak with #b#p510##k, the daughter of the store's owner.
QuestInfo.2: I met #p510#. To make the #t4031011#, she said she needs #b#t4031010##k.

0.0: Well, I do happen to have #b#t4031009##k, but I can't just hand it over. You see, I've tried using this potion several times, but I realized it doesn't work properly without a #b#t4031011##k. If you bring that to me, then I'd be more than willing to hand the medicine over.
0.1: You want to know how to get that rock? If I knew, I wouldn't be asking you for help! Here's the deal, head over to the general store in #b#m10004002##k, ask for the daughter of the owner, #b#p510##k, and see if she knows anything. She may have a clue...
0.2: You know how to get to #m10004000#, don't you? Take the exit on the right from the harbor, go past #m10003000#, up northwest. Then keep going east, and you'll find #m10004000#. Sorry, is that common knowledge?

1.0: Oh, hello. How can I help you?

npc.0: Didn't get the #b#t4031011##k yet? Oh well, it's not the easiest thing to acquire. Ah, it's so gorgeous when it shines like a star... Hurry and go see #b#p510##k at #b#m10004002##k.
